component.name: Column
component.description: One board lane: header (icon, label, count, hover-revealed actions) plus a scrollable stack of Card instances.

commonPatterns.name: phase-column
commonPatterns.description: One instance per phase value declared by the active chain, in the chain's own order.
commonPatterns.composition: <Column title="Plan" count={cards.length} icon={<PlanIcon />} actions={<Button appearance="ghost" size="icon" aria-label="Add task">+</Button>}>{cards.map(c => <Card key={c.id} {...c} />)}</Column>

antiPatterns.scenario: Using Column as a generic list container outside the board
antiPatterns.reason: its header anatomy (icon + count + hover actions) is board-specific
antiPatterns.alternative: Build a plain list for non-board use cases

antiPatterns.scenario: Hardcoding the column list in the app instead of reading flow.yaml
antiPatterns.reason: columns must come from flow.yaml's declared order
antiPatterns.alternative: Derive the Column list from flow.yaml

parentConstraints: Meant to be laid out in a horizontally-scrolling board row

accessibility.role: region with a real <h2> heading (not a styled div) for column-by-column screen reader navigation
accessibility.keyboardSupport: header actions remain reachable via :focus-within, not hover alone
accessibility.screenReader: empty column shows a text message, never a silent blank lane
accessibility.focusManagement: n/a at the Column level — delegated to its Card/Button children

aiHints.context: One per chain phase, in chain-declared order. Renders Card children in a scrollable stack.
